source_citation: Yeh, I-Cheng (2018). Real Estate Valuation [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5J30W. Introductory paper: Yeh & Hsu (2018), Applied Soft Computing. Geography: Sindian Dist., New Taipei City, Taiwan.

workbook_structure.note: Single worksheet; no additional hidden sheets in UCI archive.

columns.name: X3 distance to the nearest MRT station
Y house price of unit area

target.name: Y house price of unit area
target.meaning: House price of unit area (10k NTD/Ping)

transaction_no.risk: Unique row index (414/414); must not enter model as feature.

transaction_date.risk: Random row split mixes adjacent months; mild temporal leakage for time-sensitive market effects.
transaction_date.optional_split: Hold out whole month cohorts by X1 for temporal robustness.

latitude_longitude.risk: Repeated sales/listings at same coordinates; random split can place same-location rows in train and test.
latitude_longitude.optional_split: Group holdout by (latitude, longitude) for location robustness (259 groups).

small_sample_reliability.assessment: Test NLL and especially coverage/interval metrics will be high-variance at ~41 test points per split; 20 repetitions help aggregate stability but do not fix per-split sparsity.
small_sample_reliability.recommendation: Treat as secondary pilot; report aggregate NLL with estimated SE over repetitions; interpret coverage cautiously; do not require sharp interval conclusions.

prior_application_search.finding: No NGBoost loader in pinned official repo; bounded 2026-08-23 search found no documented NGBoost application on this UCI table.
prior_application_search.limitation: Non-exhaustive; paper-absence does not prove global non-use.

compute_feasibility.cpu_assessment: Trivial — smallest NGBoost candidate by n and p; full 20-split × 3-variant protocol feasible on CPU.
compute_feasibility.proposal_listing_policy: Full n=414 appropriate to cite with small-sample caveats for uncertainty metrics.

feature_columns_default: X3 distance to the nearest MRT station

primary_row_level_paper_aligned.approach: Row-level 90/10 holdouts, np.random.seed(1), 20 repetitions; identical splits across natural, ordinary, homoscedastic variants.
primary_row_level_paper_aligned.scientific_question: Ablation ordering under paper-aligned protocol despite small n.
primary_row_level_paper_aligned.leakage_risk: Moderate — temporal and location repetition not controlled.

preprocessing_recommendation: Load sheet1; drop No; use six UCI features X1–X6; target Y. No scaling required for tree NGBoost. Document whether X1 is retained or excluded if temporal split chosen.

feasibility.ethics_privacy: Aggregate property transaction attributes for one Taiwan district; coordinates are coarse but present — no named individuals; research use with attribution.

unresolved_concerns: Small n limits reliable per-split NLL/coverage comparisons.
Random row split leaves temporal and location leakage paths open.
